title: Perform inventory ratio analysis and interpretation

items.concept: Initial recognition of inventory purchases and freight; settlement of AP and returns; sale/COGS; inventory rollforward; inventory turnover, days in inventory, and gross profit % with trend interpretation
Number-variant twin of perpetual purchase recognition, settlements, inventory rollforward, and inventory ratio analysis
Period-end LIFO conversion adjusting JE; inventory method effects on turnover, days, and GP%; LIFO-reserve adjustment for peer comparability; disclosure/presentation of method and reserve
Classification of cost-flow method effects on inventory turnover when acquisition costs are rising
Correct computation of inventory turnover and average days in inventory
